tips.title: Assembling Trumpeter Multi-Part Gun Barrels
tips.text: For Trumpeter's detailed gun barrels (e.g., Trumpeter's 1/35 Soviet /85), dry-fit parts first. Use a toothpick dipped in Tamiya Extra Thin Cement to glue parts in place. Avoid applying cement to the entire length to prevent warping. Let cure for 30 minutes, then clean up excess cement with a needle and Vallejo Airbrush Thinner. Pin barrels to a cork board for handling during painting.

tips.title: Aligning ICM Wings with a Simple Jig
tips.text: For ICM's 1/48 aircraft kits, create a wing alignment jig using a scrap piece of plywood. Mark the centerline on the wing root and jig. Apply CA glue along the wing root, place the wing on the jig, and let cure. Once set, remove the wing and sand the jig flat. Reuse the jig for the other wing, ensuring perfect alignment.

tips.title: Installing Eduard Photo-Etch Parts
tips.text: Soak Eduard photo-etch parts in warm water for 15 minutes to soften them. Use tweezers to gently bend parts using a photo-etch bending tool. Apply a tiny drop of CA glue at the attachment point on the model, then carefully position the photo-etch part. Press gently until the glue sets. Touch up any marks with Vallejo Model Color.

tips.title: Working with Clear Prop Models Resin Conversions
tips.text: With Clear Prop Models resin conversions, wash parts in warm soapy water to remove release agents. Assemble resin parts using CA glue, applying it sparingly. For joins, apply glue to one part only, then fit parts together immediately. Let cure for 24 hours. Sand any seam lines with fine grit sandpaper, then clean with Vallejo Airbrush Thinner.

tips.title: Assembling Arma Hobby Tracks: Individual Links vs. Vinyl
tips.text: For Arma Hobby's individual track links (e.g., 1/35 WWII German Panzers), use CA glue to assemble them. Apply glue sparingly to one pin, fit links together, and let cure. For vinyl tracks, cut the track into manageable lengths, dip pins in CA glue, fit links together, and let cure. For workable tracks, follow the manufacturer's instructions. Always dry-fit tracks before painting to ensure proper alignment.
